text:
tayla: Quick brain-dump — I'm digging into TTFT vs tokens/sec for a customer bug. Where's the canonical dashboard to slice p50/p95/p99 by model + route? Need links and the exact panel names so I can point the customer.
josh: Use the 'Inference Latency Explorer' dashboard. Panels to check: 'TTFT (p50/p95/p99) by model', 'Tokens/sec (ingress) by route', and 'Request rate vs cold starts'. Link: https://grafana.internal.redwood.com/d/XYzLat/inference-latency-explorer?orgId=1
marta: For traces, use Jaeger and filter by service=inference + operation=generate. Quick link: https://jaeger.redwood-inference.local/search?service=inference. To find tail latency, filter for span name "kv_cache_miss" or long backend waits.
josh: If you're running PromQL locally, this is handy for tokens/sec per model:
```
sum by (model) (rate(redwood_tokens_processed_total[1m]))
```
and for TTFT p95 over 5m per route:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
tayla: Awesome. On the alerting side — current p95 alert is triggering too often for bursty routes. Current rule (example): `p95(ttft) > 0.8s for 5m`. Thinking: split alerts by route type (warm vs cold) and add a tokens/sec cooldown condition. Thoughts?
marta: +1 split alerts. Proposal: keep p95 > 0.8s for warm routes, but set p95 > 1.2s for known cold-start routes and only fire if `sum(rate(tokens_processed_total[5m])) by (route) > 10` to avoid noisy low-volume routes.
sre-bot: alert:latency_p95_inference — 42 incidents in last 24h. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.com/latency-ttft-runbook. Suggested play: check TTFT p95 panel, look at tokens/sec, then grab a Jaeger trace for top offenders.
josh: Also add a short-lived suppression when deploys are detected. We get noisy alerts for rollout spikes. We have deploy webhook at `#deploys` — could add `alerts.suppression: recent_deploy=1h` logic.
tayla: Can someone paste the exact panel id for TTFT by model? I want to include it in the postmortem.
marta: Panel id is `panelId=21` on that dashboard. Full deep link: https://grafana.internal.redwood.com/d/XYzLat/inference-latency-explorer?viewPanel=21&orgId=1&var-model=all
josh: One more tip — for tokens/sec anomalies, look at the derived metric `tokens_per_request = tokens_processed_total / requests_total` then multiply by request rate to get tokens/sec headroom.
tayla: Plan: I will update the alert RFC with split thresholds, add tokens/sec guard, and request a 1h deploy suppression. Assigning action items:
- tayla: draft RFC + test alerts in staging
- josh: add suppression logic example and link to deploy webhook
- marta: verify panel ids and Jaeger filters, add examples to runbook
marta: ack. I'll also add a short log snippet you can paste for customers:
```
TRACEID=abc123 ttft_seconds=0.512 p50=0.12 p95=0.81 tokens=124 route=/v1/complete model=redwood-xl
```
tayla: perfect — I'll assemble and post in #customer-updates today. Thanks all :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Note: if you change alert thresholds, please include a revert plan in the RFC to avoid missed regressions.
